tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I found Acme Supplies's invoices, but there are two approved ones, and I want to pay the right one exactly once:

- **INV-45131** — $6,853.44, due 2026-11-04
- **INV-37191** — $3,551.99, due 2026-11-25

(There's also a paid invoice, INV-20002, and a draft one, INV-78192, which I'll leave alone.)

Could you confirm which invoice you'd like me to pay by wire? Both are under $10,000, so no controller approval is needed.

trace.message: Pay INV-37191, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-37191, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
Done — INV-37191 has been paid in full by wire:

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-37191 (Acme Supplies)
- **Amount:** $3,551.99
- **Rail:** Wire
- **Status:** Sent

The invoice is now marked as paid, and I used an idempotency key so the payment executed exactly once. The disputed invoice (INV-45131) was left unpaid, and the draft invoice (INV-78192) remains untouched.
